scope: All 152 NVIDIA and 8 Intel product IDs already in catalog/gpu.json. No new products.
priceDefinition: Nominal original US launch MSRP / manufacturer-announced starting retail price; excludes sales tax. Not street price, not current price, not inflation-adjusted.
dateDefinition: date is the publication date of the announcement establishing the launch price, not necessarily first retail availability. Null if not established.
method: Primary manufacturer announcements, official localized manufacturer blogs explicitly quoting USD, corporate press releases syndicated by GlobeNewswire or explicitly labeled Direct Release, NVIDIA-published GTC presentation, and Microsoft official launch partner announcement. VRAM/Founders/OEM variants are kept separate. An amount is null when the exact variant lacks adequate evidence.
limitations: Incomplete price coverage is intentional; unverified values must display unavailable and be excluded from ratios.
Historic starting prices do not represent current used/new purchase prices or realistic availability.
GTX 1070/1080 use base partner MSRP; RTX 2070/2080/2080 Ti explicitly labeled Founders Edition use the higher Founders MSRP.
Arc A770 16 GB uses Intel Limited Edition MSRP, not a claim about all partner boards.
TFLOPS per dollar expresses theoretical FP32 throughput per historical launch dollar, not gaming FPS or purchasing value across architectures.
Some announcement links are localized archives; all recorded amounts are explicitly dollar/USD amounts, never converted from regional currencies.
